verses.en: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.pt: Depois daquela praga disse o Senhor a Moisés e a Eleazar, filho do sacerdote Arão:
verses.en_web: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Now after the disease was over, the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest,

verses.en: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.pt: Tomai a soma de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, da idade de vinte anos para cima, segundo as casas e seus pais, todos os que em Israel podem sair à guerra.
verses.en_web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: Let all the children of Israel be numbered, by the names of their fathers' families, all those of twenty years old and over who are able to go to war in Israel.

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.pt: Falaram-lhes, pois, Moisés e Eleazar o sacerdote, nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, na altura de Jericó, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.en_bbe: So Moses and Eleazar the priest gave them the order in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, saying,

verses.en: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Contai o povo da idade de vinte anos para cima; como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés e aos filhos de Israel que saíram da terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those that came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Let all the people of twenty years old and over be numbered, as the Lord has given orders to Moses and the children of Israel who have come out of Egypt.

verses.en: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
verses.pt: Rúben, o primogênito de Israel; os filhos de Rúben: de Hanoque, a família dos hanoquitas; de Palu, a família dos paluítas;
verses.en_web: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
verses.en_bbe: Reuben, the first son of Israel: the sons of Reuben by their families: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

verses.en: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.pt: de Hezrom, a família dos hezronitas; de Carmi, a família dos carmitas.
verses.en_web: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.en_bbe: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

verses.en: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias dos rubenitas; os que foram deles contados eram quarenta e três mil setecentos e trinta.
verses.en_web: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of the Reubenites: their number was forty-three thousand, seven hundred and thirty.

verses.en: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
verses.pt: E o filho de Palu: Eliabe.
verses.en_web: The sons of Pallu: Eliab.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Pallu, Eliab

verses.en: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Eliabe: Nemuel, Dato e Abirão. Estes são aqueles Datã e Abirão que foram chamados da congregação, os quais contenderam contra Moisés e contra Arão na companhia de Corá, quando contenderam contra o Senhor,
verses.en_web: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they rebelled against Yahweh,
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had a place in the meeting of the people, who together with Korah made an outcry against Moses and Aaron and against the Lord:

verses.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
verses.pt: e a terra abriu a boca, e os tragou juntamente com Corá, quando pereceu aquela companhia; quando o fogo devorou duzentos e cinqüenta homens, os quais serviram de advertência.
verses.en_web: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
verses.en_bbe: And they went down into the open mouth of the earth, together with Korah, when death overtook him and all his band; at the time when two hundred and fifty men were burned in the fire, and they became a sign.

verses.en: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
verses.pt: Todavia os filhos de Corá não morreram.
verses.en_web: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
verses.en_bbe: But death did not overtake the sons of Korah.

verses.en: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Simeão, segundo as suas famílias: de Nemuel, a família dos nemuelitas; de Jamim, a família dos jaminitas; de Jaquim, a família dos jaquinitas;
verses.en_web: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Simeon by their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

verses.en: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.pt: de Zerá, a família dos zeraítas; de Saul, a família dos saulitas.
verses.en_web: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.en_bbe: Of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

verses.en: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias dos simeonitas, vinte e dois mil e duzentos.
verses.en_web: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand, two hundred.

verses.en: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Gade, segundo as suas famílias: de Zefom, a família dos zefonitas; de Hagui, a família dos haguitas; de Suni, a família dos sunitas;
verses.en_web: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Gad by their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

verses.en: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
verses.pt: de Ozni, a família dos oznitas; de Eri, a família dos eritas;
verses.en_web: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
verses.en_bbe: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

verses.en: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
verses.pt: de Arode, a família dos aroditas; de Areli, a família dos arelitas.
verses.en_web: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
verses.en_bbe: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

verses.en: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Gade, segundo os que foram deles contados, quarenta mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of the sons of Gad as they were numbered, forty thousand, five hundred.

verses.en: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Judá: Er e Onã; mas Er e Onã morreram na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Judah, Er and Onan: and Er and Onan had come to their death in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
verses.pt: Assim os filhos de Judá, segundo as suas famílias, eram: de Selá, a família dos selanitas; de Pérez, a família dos perezitas; de Zerá, a família dos zeraítas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Judah by their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelahites: of Perez, the family of the Perezites: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

verses.en: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Pérez eram: de Hezrom, a família dos hezronitas; de Hamul, a família dos hamulitas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

verses.en: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias de Judá, segundo os que foram deles contados, setenta e seis mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of Judah as they were numbered, seventy-six thousand, five hundred.

verses.en: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Issacar, segundo as suas famílias: de Tola, a família dos tolaítas; de Puva, a família dos puvitas;
verses.en_web: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Issachar by their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Puvah, the family of the Punites:

verses.en: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
verses.pt: de Jasube, a família dos jasubitas; de Sinrom, a família dos sinronitas.
verses.en_web: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
verses.en_bbe: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

verses.en: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias de Issacar, segundo os que foram deles contados, sessenta e quatro mil e trezentos:
verses.en_web: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of Issachar, as they were numbered, sixty-four thousand, three hundred.

verses.en: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Zebulom, segundo as suas famílias: de Serede, a família dos sereditas; de Elom, a família dos elonitas; de Jaleel, a família dos jaleelitas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Zebulun by their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

verses.en: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias dos zebulonitas, segundo os que foram deles contados, sessenta mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of the Zebulunites as they were numbered, sixty thousand, five hundred.

verses.en: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.pt: Os filhos de José, segundo as suas familias: Manassés e Efraim.
verses.en_web: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Joseph by their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.en: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Manassés: de Maquir, a família dos maquiritas; e Maquir gerou a Gileade; de Gileade, a família dos gileaditas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir was the father of Gilead: of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

verses.en: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Gileade: de Iezer, a família dos iezritas; de Heleque, a família dos helequitas;
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

verses.en: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
verses.pt: de Asriel, a família dos asrielitas; de Siquém, a família dos siquemitas;
verses.en_web: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
verses.en_bbe: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

verses.en: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.pt: e de Semida, a família dos semidaítas; e de Hefer, a família dos heferitas.
verses.en_web: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.en_bbe: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

verses.en: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.pt: Ora, Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, não tinha filhos, senão filhas; e as filhas de Zelofeade chamavam-se Macla, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.
verses.en_web: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.en_bbe: And Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, had no sons, but only daughters, and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.en: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias de Manassés; os que foram deles contados, eram cinqüenta e dois mil e setecentos.
verses.en_web: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand, seven hundred.

verses.en: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Efraim, segundo as suas famílias: de Sutela, a família dos sutelaítas; de Bequer, a família dos bequeritas; de Taã, a família dos taanitas.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Ephraim by their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites: of Becher, the family of the Becherites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.pt: E estes são os filhos de Sutela: de Erã, a família dos eranitas.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites:

verses.en: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Efraim, segundo os que foram deles contados, trinta e dois mil e quinhentos. Estes são os filhos de José, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of Ephraim as they were numbered, thirty-two thousand, five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph by their families.

verses.en: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias: de Belá, a família dos belaítas; de Asbel, a família dos asbelitas; de Airão, a família dos airamitas;
verses.en_web: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Benjamin by their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

verses.en: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.pt: de Sefufã, a família dos sufamitas; de Hufão, a família dos hufamitas.
verses.en_web: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.en_bbe: Of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites: and of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

verses.en: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Belá eram Arde e Naamã: de Arde a família dos arditas; de Naamã, a família dos naamitas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

verses.en: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias; os que foram deles contados, eram quarenta e cinco mil e seiscentos.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Benjamin by their families: and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand, six hundred.

verses.en: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Dã, segundo as suas famílias: de Suão a família dos suamitas. Estas são as famílias de Dã, segundo as suas famílias.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Dan by their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan by their families.

verses.en: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: Todas as famílias dos suamitas, segundo os que foram deles contados, eram sessenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: All the families of the Shuhamites, as they were numbered, were sixty-four thousand, four hundred.

verses.en: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Aser, segundo as suas famílias: de Imná, a família dos imnitas; de Isvi, a família dos isvitas; de Berias, a família dos beritas.
verses.en_web: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Asher by their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites: of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

verses.en: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Berias: de Heber, a família dos heberitas; de Malquiel, a família dos malquielitas.
verses.en_web: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites:

verses.en: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
verses.pt: E a filha de Aser chamava-se Sera.
verses.en_web: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
verses.en_bbe: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

verses.en: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Aser, segundo os que foram deles contados, cinqüenta e três mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of the sons of Asher as they were numbered, fifty-three thousand, four hundred.

verses.en: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias: de Jazeel, a família dos jazeelitas; de Guni, a família dos gunitas;
verses.en_web: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Naphtali by their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

verses.en: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.pt: de Jezer, a família dos jezeritas; de Silém, a família dos silemitas.
verses.en_web: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.en_bbe: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

verses.en: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias; os que foram deles contados, eram quarenta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.
verses.en_web: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of Naphtali by their families: and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand, four hundred.

verses.en: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.pt: Estes são os que foram contados dos filhos de Israel, seiscentos e um mil setecentos e trinta.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.en_bbe: Those who were numbered of the children of Israel were six hundred and one thousand, seven hundred and thirty.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.pt: A estes se repartirá a terra em herança segundo o número dos nomes.
verses.en_web: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.en_bbe: Let there be a division of the land among these, for their heritage, in relation to the number of names.

verses.en: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
verses.pt: Â tribo de muitos darás herança maior, e à de poucos darás herança menor; a cada qual se dará a sua herança segundo os que foram deles contados.
verses.en_web: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.
verses.en_bbe: To those families who are more in number, give a greater heritage; to those who are less in number, a smaller part: to every one let the heritage be given in relation to the number in his family.

verses.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.pt: Todavia a terra se repartirá por sortes; segundo os nomes das tribos de seus pais a herdarão.
verses.en_web: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.en_bbe: But let the distribution of the land be made by the decision of the Lord: by the names of the tribes of their fathers let their heritage be given them.

verses.en: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
verses.pt: Segundo sair a sorte, se repartirá a herança deles entre as tribos de muitos e as de poucos.
verses.en_web: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”
verses.en_bbe: As it is ordered by the decision of the Lord, let distribution be made between those who are more in number and those who are less.

verses.en: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.pt: Também estes são os que foram contados dos levitas, segundo as suas famílias: de Gérson, a família dos gersonitas; de Coate, a família dos coatitas; de Merári, a família os meraritas.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.en_bbe: These were those of the Levites who were numbered by their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

verses.en: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.pt: Estas são as famílias de Levi: a família dos libnitas, a família dos hebronitas, a família dos malitas, a família dos musitas, a família dos coraítas. Ora, Coate gerou a Anrão.
verses.en_web: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
verses.en_bbe: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath was the father of Amram.

verses.en: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.pt: E a mulher de Anrão chamava-se Joquebede, filha de Levi, a qual nasceu a Levi no Egito; e de Anrão ela teve Arão e Moisés, e Miriã, irmã deles.
verses.en_web: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.en_bbe: Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom he had in Egypt: by Amram she had Moses and Aaron and their sister Miriam.

verses.en: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.pt: E a Arão nasceram Nadabe e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
verses.en_web: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.en_bbe: Aaron's sons were Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.en: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
verses.pt: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram quando ofereceram fogo estranho perante o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Death overtook Nadab and Abihu when they made an offering of strange fire before the Lord.

verses.en: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.pt: E os que foram deles contados eram vinte e três mil, todos os homens da idade de um mês para cima; porque não foram contados entre os filhos de Israel, porquanto não lhes foi dada herança entre os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Of these, twenty-three thousand males, from one month old and over, were numbered: they were not numbered with the rest of the children of Israel, for they had no heritage among the children of Israel.

verses.en: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.pt: Esses são os que foram contados por Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, que contaram os filhos de Israel nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, na altura de Jericó.
verses.en_web: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.en_bbe: All these were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when the children of Israel were numbered in the lowlands of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

verses.en: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.pt: Entre esses, porém, não se achava nenhum daqueles que tinham sido contados por Moisés e Arão, o sacerdote, quando contaram os filhos de Israel no deserto de Sinai.
verses.en_web: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.en_bbe: But among all these was not one of those numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when the children of Israel were numbered in the waste land of Sinai.

verses.en: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.pt: Porque o senhor dissera deles: Certamente morrerão no deserto; pelo que nenhum deles ficou, senão Calebe, filho de Jefoné, e Josué, filho de Num.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord had said of them, Death will certainly overtake them in the waste land. And of them all, only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua, the son of Nun, were still living.
